info.title: HOTEL PMS implemented Phase 3 identity contract
info.description: Implemented-only contract for P03 identity, sessions, memberships, roles, grants, approvals and audit. Operations listed here exist in apps/api; planned V1 operations remain in v1.openapi.json and are not implied running. Tenant ids sent by the browser are compared with the server-side session context before any policy decision.

get.description: Returns the current server-side session, memberships and CSRF token echo. When unauthenticated it returns authenticated=false without revealing whether a cookie existed.
Starts Authorization Code Flow with PKCE and redirects to Keycloak. redirect_after must be a local relative path.

Validates state, nonce, PKCE, signature, issuer, audience and expiry; rotates the session id, sets HttpOnly session and CSRF cookies, then redirects to the web origin. Failures redirect with a fixed safe error code and no tokens.

post.description: Revokes the server-side session and clears cookies. end_session_url points to Keycloak when discovery is available.

get.description: Lists memberships for the current user. Tenant ids are never accepted from the body.

post.description: Activates a tenant for the session after verifying an ACTIVE membership. Suspended or revoked memberships are rejected.

get.description: Reading another membership's permissions additionally requires role.manage inside the policy evaluator.
Requires role.read inside the policy evaluator.

post.description: Rejects removing the last active admin. Access is revoked for the next request and for jobs that have not started.

Creates one single-use local invitation. A role-bearing invitation is gated by the same policy as a direct role grant (role.grant, MFA and approval for tenant scope); the optional x-approval-id header carries that approval. The raw token is returned exactly once; no external email is sent.
Accepts a pending invitation after matching the authenticated verified email. Expired, revoked or reused tokens are rejected.
Creates a custom role within the fixed permission catalog. A role cannot include permissions the actor does not hold.

patch.description: System roles are immutable. Permission changes are validated against the actor's own effective permissions.

post.description: TENANT-scope and DENY grants require an approved request with the same hash; pass x-approval-id. PROPERTIES scope requires a non-empty property list. Granting cannot exceed the actor's own permissions.
Rejects revoking the last admin capability.

get.description: Central fixed permission catalog with stable codes. UI visibility never replaces server decisions.
Append-only audit trail, redacted before storage. Cursor is created_at|id.

post.description: The server canonicalizes the payload into request_hash, bound to action, version, currency and amount where applicable. The requester cannot approve their own request.
The approver must be a different user with the action permission and a valid MFA signal; expired approvals are rejected.
Only the requester can cancel a pending request.

session.name: hotel_session
session.description: HttpOnly server-side session cookie; tokens are never placed in browser storage.

TenantId.name: tenantId
TenantId.description: Must match the active tenant recorded in the server-side session.

Error.description: Fixed error code, localized message key, correlation id and bounded details without secrets
